selector.rationale: The patient's Holter monitor recording showed a 23.8-second ventricular asystole during syncope with gradual slowing of the sinus rate and atrioventricular conduction, which is more consistent with Sick Sinus Syndrome.

rejected.label: Atrioventricular Block
rejected.why: Although the patient experienced complete atrioventricular block, it was transient and part of a broader pattern of sinus node dysfunction, making Sick Sinus Syndrome a more comprehensive diagnosis.
